description: This file defines Django ORM models for a recipe/cooking application, including classes for Space, Food, Unit, Supermarket, and related entities, along with utility functions and custom managers.

classes.name: TreeManager
classes.description: Custom manager for hierarchical tree models, providing create and get_or_create methods compatible with MP_Node.

classes.name: TreeModel
classes.description: Abstract base class for tree-structured models, providing methods for ancestor/descendant retrieval and name representation.

classes.name: MergeModelMixin
classes.description: Mixin providing a simple merge_into method to replace an object with another, with checks for space and hierarchy.

classes.name: PermissionModelMixin
classes.description: Mixin providing methods for permission-related attributes, such as owner, shared objects, and space retrieval.

classes.name: FoodInheritField
classes.description: Model representing fields that can be inherited by Food objects, with a string representation.

classes.name: Space
classes.description: Model representing a user space, including theming, permissions, and safe deletion of related objects.

classes.name: AiProvider
classes.description: Model representing an AI service provider with API details and description.

classes.name: AiLog
classes.description: Model logging AI operations, including function, tokens, timing, and associated provider.

classes.name: ConnectorConfig
classes.description: Model configuring external connectors, such as HomeAssistant, with URL, tokens, and enabled status.

classes.name: UserPreference
classes.description: Model storing user-specific preferences for themes, layout, and other UI/UX settings.

classes.name: UserSpace
classes.description: Model linking users to spaces with roles, groups, and activity status.

classes.name: Storage
classes.description: Model representing external storage configurations like Dropbox or Nextcloud.

classes.name: Sync
classes.description: Model representing synchronization status and configuration for storage.

classes.name: SupermarketCategory
classes.description: Model for categorizing supermarkets, with merge capabilities.

classes.name: Supermarket
classes.description: Model representing a supermarket, with categories and shopping lists.

classes.name: SupermarketCategoryRelation
classes.description: Model linking supermarkets and categories with an order.

classes.name: SyncLog
classes.description: Logging model for sync operations.

classes.name: Keyword
classes.description: Hierarchical keyword model with inheritance and ordering.

classes.name: Unit
classes.description: Model for measurement units, supporting inheritance and merging.

classes.name: Food
classes.description: Hierarchical food item model with inheritance, substitutions, and properties.

methods.name: get_user_display_name
methods.description: Returns a user's display name, prioritizing first and last name.

methods.name: get_active_space
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active space for a user.

methods.name: get_shopping_share
methods.description: Fetches users sharing shopping lists with the given user via raw SQL.

methods.name: oauth_token_get_owner
methods.description: Returns the owner user of an OAuth token.

methods.name: get_model_name
methods.description: Converts a model class name to a snake_case string.
